items.q: Which allergens are in your drinks?
items.a: Depending on the recipe, our drinks may contain milk and gluten (Oreo, for example). Tell us about any allergy at the counter and we'll tell you what works. A detailed list per drink is coming soon.
Yes. Fresh fruit teas and oolongs come without milk. For frappés, ask for the coconut milk versions (mango, strawberry, coconut).

items.q: How do I pick the sugar level?
items.a: Choose 0%, 30%, 50%, 70% or 100%. 100% is the house recipe. If you're unsure, 50% suits almost everyone.
Every drink is made to order. Around snack time and at weekends it can get busy: send your order on WhatsApp before you come to save time.
Yes, contactless delivery with Uber Eats during opening hours. For a group order, message us and we'll sort it out together.
